messages:
Anya: quick heads-up, kumori-v2 (int8) landed in staging and we see a ko+zh regression. BLEU ~ -6 on ko_zh_mixed_dev, some integration checks failing. repro attached.

eval-bot: REGRESSION_SUMMARY: model=kumori-v2-int8 metric=BLEU delta=-6.2 dataset=ko_zh_mixed_dev id=RG-2026-311

Sasha: can you paste a minimal example + token ids?

Anya: example: input: "서울역 北京行 버스가"
baseline (fp16): "버스가 서울역 北京(북)으로"
int8: "버스가 서울역 京으로"  -- lost han grouping

Token ids baseline -> int8: [1342,9001,2345,7810] -> [1342,9001,2350,7810] (2345 -> 2350)

Kevin: looks like a vocab remap during quant serialization. Any converter logs?

Anya: small snippet from converter: 
[2026-02-11 08:12:03] serialize_vocab remap_table_entries=3
[2026-02-11 08:12:03] applied_remap {old:2345,new:2350}

Lia: two likely causes: (A) serializer remap heuristic bumped token indices to avoid collisions, (B) runtime int8 preprocess changed ZWJ/ZWSP handling.

Kevin: starting bisect across quantizer commits 2026-02-01..2026-02-12 with the ko_zh fixture. Command: ./tools/quant_bisect --model kumori-v2 --from 2026-02-01 --to 2026-02-12 --repro tests/fixtures/ko_zh_mixed.txt

Tori: add a token-id-stability smoke check to staging gating for mixed-script sentences. If tokenizer mapping changes silently we need alerts.

Anya: pinned staging to kumori-v2-fp16, blocked int8 canary. Created ENG-ML-1284 to track cross-locale sanity runs (zh-jp, ja-kr).

Kevin: bisect points to commit 2026-02-09 sha d9f7e8, serializer remap introduced naive collision solver. Opening PR to revert and add deterministic tests.

Tori: after revert, run quant vs fp16 smoke fleet across top locales and add a regression guard in quant CI that fails on token-id shifts for saved vocab artifacts.

Anya: follow-ups assigned: Kevin=PR+bisect writeup; Anya=token-stability tests + smoke run; Tori=CI alerting/gate; Lia=serializer review and deterministic proposal

Sasha: thanks, post PR link and final eval numbers here. :thumbsup:
